preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 20.
Length of strings A and B is between 1 and 1000 for each test case.

preconditions.expression: for each test case, len(A) == len(B) == N
preconditions.description: Strings A and B have the same length N.

preconditions.expression: for each test case, A and B contain only lowercase English letters
preconditions.description: Strings A and B contain only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to convert A to B, output '-1'.

postconditions.expression: if conversion is possible, output K followed by K operations
postconditions.description: If it is possible to convert A to B, output K followed by K operations.

postconditions.expression: each operation is described by a positive integer Z and Z distinct integers from {0, 1, ..., N-1}
postconditions.description: Each operation is described by a positive integer Z and Z distinct integers from {0, 1, ..., N-1}.

postconditions.expression: after all operations, A should be equal to B
postconditions.description: After performing all operations, A should be equal to B.
